create_TensorListDataset: create a TensorListDataset from a list of PyTorch tensors for use as a PyTorch Dataset
test_StreamingShuffleDataset_set_epoch: test that StreamingShuffleDataset produces different shuffle orders across epochs and reproducible order within the same epoch
use_StreamingShuffleDataset: wrap a PyTorch Dataset with StreamingShuffleDataset using a seed for reproducible shuffling per epoch
run_get_simple_dataset: run get_simple_dataset to create a sample TensorListDataset with six LongTensor entries
compare_dataset_iterations: compare two dataset iterations element by element using the _compare helper method
